headline: Chilean peso falls as US dollar holds firmly above 1,000 CLP benchmark
summary: The Chilean peso declined further as the US dollar closed above the 1,000 CLP mark for a second consecutive session. Increased speculative positions against the peso reflected broad dollar strength.
why: The exchange rate of the Chilean peso is a key determinant of domestic imported product costs and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: USDCLP
impacts.why: Global US dollar strength pushed the Chilean peso past key psychological resistance levels.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong global demand for US dollars led traders to open short positions against the Chilean currency.
